data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in FCBM and BMRC.

FCBM reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.5M versus $12.1M a year earlier, down 54.2% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000162828026056931/0001628280-26-056931-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
